Package com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote

Class ExecutionQuoteService

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote.ExecutionQuoteService
public class ExecutionQuoteService extends Object
Retrieves the latest quote during execution and makes a deterministic freshness decision.

  • Constructor Details

    • ExecutionQuoteService

      public ExecutionQuoteService(ExecutionOrderContextRepository orders, QuoteRepository quotes, QuoteFreshnessPolicy freshness, Clock clock, long maximumQuoteAttempts)
      Creates a ExecutionQuoteService with the supplied dependencies.
      Parameters:
      orders - repository supplying eligible order context
      quotes - repository supplying the latest market quote
      freshness - timestamp freshness policy
      clock - clock supplying execution evaluation instants
      maximumQuoteAttempts - positive attempt limit for unavailable or unusable quotes
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the attempt limit is less than one

  • Method Details

    • selectForExecution

      public ExecutionQuoteDecision selectForExecution(UUID orderId)
      Selects the latest quote and evaluates its timestamp against the execution clock. Unavailable, stale or excessively future-dated quotes request a retry until the persisted attempt count reaches the limit, then rejection. No order state is changed.
      Parameters:
      orderId - persistent identifier of an accepted PENDING order
      Returns:
      quote evidence, evaluation time, action and reason
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order is unavailable or ineligible
